name.text: Construction Reflection across a Random Line

questiontext.text:
Task: Reflect the triangle across the given line.

Click each vertex (A, B, C), then click where you think its reflected image (A′, B′, C′) should be.

[[jsxgraph width="600px" height="600px" input-ref-ans1="ans1Ref"]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-10, 10, 10, -10], axis: true, showCopyright: false }); // Load random variables from STACK var pts = {#pts#}; var m = {#m#}; var c = {#c#}; // --- Draw reflection line: y = m*x + c --- var reflLine = board.create('functiongraph', [ function(x) { return m * x + c; }, -10, 10 ], { strokeColor: 'blue', dash: 2, strokeWidth: 2, name: 'Reflection line' }); // --- Draw original triangle --- var labels = ['A', 'B', 'C']; var objPts = []; for (var i=0; i { if (!usedPts.has(j)) t.setAttribute({fillColor:'#1f77b4'}); }); clickedPoint = objPts[i]; clickedPoint.setAttribute({fillColor:'red'}); }); } board.on('down', function(e){ if (!clickedPoint) return; var cPos = board.getMousePosition(e); var coords = new JXG.Coords(JXG.COORDS_SCREEN, cPos, board); var xClick = coords.usrCoords[1]; var yClick = coords.usrCoords[2]; var idx = objPts.indexOf(clickedPoint); var labelPrime = labels[idx] + "'"; var studPt = board.create('point', [xClick, yClick], { size: 3, name: labelPrime, fillColor: '#ff7f0e', label: {offset:[-10,10]} }); reflectedPts.push(studPt); usedPts.add(idx); clickedPoint.setAttribute({fillColor:'#b0b0b0'}); clickedPoint = null; if (reflectedPts.length === objPts.length){ board.create('polygon', reflectedPts, { fillColor: '#fdd0a2', borders: {strokeColor:'#ff7f0e'} }); } }); stack_jxg.bind_point_list('ans1Ref', reflectedPts); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]
